name: Request a new 3rd party grammar repository

title: "(request org repo) highlightjs-[name of your grammar]"
labels: language

---

We no longer host new third-party grammar repositories in the highlight.js organization.

Host the repo yourself, then open a pull request that adds your grammar to [`SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.md`](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/blob/main/SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.md).

See the [3rd party contribution guide](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/blob/main/extra/3RD_PARTY_QUICK_START.md).
